question: Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.
sql:
WITH step_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name, 
        version, 
        step,
        model,
        test_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY name, version, step) as max_non_stack_score,
        test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
),
step_comparison AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        name,
        version,
        step,
        max_non_stack_score,
        stack_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN max_non_stack_score < stack_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN max_non_stack_score = stack_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE 'other'
        END as status
    FROM step_stats
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT 
        name, 
        version,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_strong,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'soft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as soft_count,
        COUNT(*) as total_steps
    FROM step_comparison
    GROUP BY name, version
),
models_with_status AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.name,
        ms.version,
        ms.has_strong,
        ms.soft_count,
        ms.total_steps,
        m.L1_model
    FROM model_status ms
    JOIN model m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
models_with_strong_or_soft AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        L1_model,
        CASE 
            WHEN has_strong = 1 THEN 'strong'
            WHEN soft_count = total_steps THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END as status
    FROM models_with_status
),
l1_model_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        status,
        L1_model,
        COUNT(DISTINCT name) as model_count
    FROM models_with_strong_or_soft
    WHERE status IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        status,
        L1_model,
        model_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY model_count DESC, L1_model) as rn
    FROM l1_model_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, model_count as occurrences
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY status
